payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcome.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

check.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
check.complete_when: The image is visibly rendered as a chalk drawing, with chalk-like texture and drawing treatment across the scene.
check.partial_when: A chalk-drawing treatment is visibly present but incomplete or uneven, so the image retains substantial photographic or non-chalk-rendered areas.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no chalk-drawing transformation has been made.
check.unknown_when: The available image evidence is insufficient to determine whether a chalk-drawing transformation was made.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited scene is visibly rendered with a chalk-like drawing treatment across the giraffes and background, including soft grainy texture, smudged shading, and sketch-like outlines; it no longer reads as an ordinary photograph."}
